metadata.architectural_response: A single occupied courtyard solid changes orientation continuously through its height. The central opening and surrounding rooms twist together, creating a spatial relation through section rather than separate rotated blocks.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: Programme, doors, stairs, accessible roof routes, structural member capacity and parking operation remain to be designed and independently verified.
